OpenCC_design_PRs.title: Generate regional ST phrases from HK/TW dictionaries
OpenCC_design_PRs.body:
Add STPhrases_GeneratedFromRegionalPhrases as a generated Simplified-to-Traditional bridge dictionary derived from the first column of HKPhrases.txt and TWPhrases.txt. The generator projects regional phrase keys through t2s.json, skips short projected keys that would be unsafe for segmentation, deduplicates identical projections, and fails if a projected Simplified key maps to conflicting regional phrase keys.

Wire the generated dictionary into the ST phrase stage for all standard Simplified-to-Traditional configs. mmseg configs use it for both segmentation and first-stage conversion; jieba configs keep jieba segmentation resources unchanged and load the generated dictionary only in the conversion chain.

Build the generated dictionary in Bazel, CMake, and node-gyp. CMake uses the opencc CLI after generating the t2s dictionaries, while node-gyp uses the node addon backend and then compiles the generated text dictionary to ocd2.

Remove STPhrases entries that are now exact duplicates of the generated regional bridge dictionary, so regional phrase keys only need to be maintained in HKPhrases/TWPhrases unless t2s projection does not match real Simplified input.

Update dictionary validation for the generated regional dictionary, including the non-BMP U+2BAC7 projection, add a conversion regression for 仙童半导体厂 -> 快捷半導體廠, and keep node package/prebuild checks aware of the generated resource.

This commit does not address a similar tw2sp conversion error.

Fixes #1314

OpenCC_design_PRs.title: Replace merged ST phrase dictionary with union group across configs
OpenCC_design_PRs.body:
Remove the statically-merged STPhrases_WithGeneratedFromRegionalPhrases artifact and instead express the same semantics as a union group of STPhrases and STPhrases_GeneratedFromRegionalPhrases in all five s2* configs and their jieba counterparts.  The union match policy introduced in the previous commit makes this equivalent at runtime: longest prefix wins, with STPhrases taking priority on same-length ties, which is exactly what the merged dict enforced.

Detailed Changes:
- **Config updates (s2t, s2tw, s2hk, s2twp, s2hkp and jieba variants)**:
  - Replace single-file segmentation dict with union group [STPhrases, STPhrases_Generated].
  - Replace merged dict in conversion stage 1 with union group nested inside the existing short_circuit group alongside STCharacters.
- **Build system**:
  - Remove generate_STPhrases_WithGeneratedFromRegionalPhrases genrule from BUILD.bazel.
  - Remove corresponding entry and generation commands from data/CMakeLists.txt.
  - Remove two node-gyp actions from node/dicts.gypi.
- **Tests**:
  - Remove STPhrases_WithGeneratedFromRegionalPhrases allowlist entries from DictionaryNonBmpTest.cpp (no longer a separate dict to audit).
  - Update node/test.js CLI resolution test to copy the two source dicts instead of the former merged artifact.

Reverts #1349
Fixes #1350
